description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/project_docs/raw_project_brief.txt to extract minimum necessary information per Step 2 of the skill. (2) Apply Step 3 to locate the project within the bespoke 三层九阶段模型 (Three-Layer Nine-Stage model), explicitly naming all three layers (共创生成层/验证转译层/放大闭环层), identifying the current stage, and surfacing the '最大断点'. (3) Apply Step 4's 五维诊断 across all five exact dimensions (技术可转化性/共创组织成熟度/价值转译清晰度/市场验证充分度/生态与制度支撑度). (4) Reference the four core variables (共创强度/转译能力/验证质量/生态支撑) and proprietary concepts like MVTP (最小可行转化产品), 双十验证, and 权责建模. (5) Produce diagnosis_roadmap.md as a '路线图版' delivery and pitch_reconstruction.md as a '比赛/路演版' delivery per Step 5, both containing structured sections with concrete action items, market segmentation advice, and value proposition translation grounded in the skill's framework rather than generic consulting output.
